}

.wsu-custom-side-nav::before {

}

	font-size: 1.5rem;
	font-weight: 800;
	color: #808080;
}

	content: "";
	display: inline-block;
	height: 36px;
	width: 36px;
	vertical-align: middle;
	margin-right: 1.25rem;
	background-image: url(https://s3.wp.wsu.edu/uploads/sites/625/2022/07/Group-2064.png);
	background-size: contain;
	background-repeat: no-repeat;
	background-position: center;
}

	content: "";
	left: 0;
	width: 100%;
	height: 50%;
	bottom: 0;
	position: absolute;
	display: block;
	background-color: #F9F9F9;
}

.wsu-custom-campus-profile__table {
	align-items: center;
}
.wsu-custom-campus-profile__table figure {
	flex-grow: 1;
}

.wsu-custom-campus-profile__table table {
	border-top: none !important;
	margin-bottom: 0 !important;
}

	border-top: 1px solid #d9d9d9 !important;
	border-bottom: 1px solid #d9d9d9 !important;
}
.wsu-custom-campus-profile__stats {
	background-color: #F9F9F9;
}

.wsu-custom-campus-profile .wsu-stat {
	padding-left: 1.125rem;
}

.wsu-custom-campus-profile .wsu-stat::after {
	content: "";
	height: 8px;

color: #808080;

	position:absolute;

}

  .wsu-stats-grid-3 { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
}
@media (max-width: 560px) {
  .wsu-stats-grid-2,
  .wsu-stats-grid-3 { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}
 
 
/* ---- Every Coug Starts with a Scholarship (dark band) ---- */
 
.wsu-afford-range {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
  border-left: 4px solid #E9C576; /* wheat field */
  border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0;
  padding: 22px 26px;
}
.wsu-afford-range--oos {
  border-left-color: #6AC9CE; /* alpine lake */
}
.wsu-afford-range p {
  margin: 0;
}
.wsu-afford-range__who {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
  margin-bottom: 6px !important;
}
.wsu-afford-range__amt {
  line-height: 1;
}
.wsu-afford-range__amt .wsu-afford--stat-value {
  font-size: 40px;
  color: #FFFFFF;
}
.wsu-afford-range__note {
  font-size: 14px;
  margin-top: 8px !important;
}
 
 
/* ---- Sticker price vs net price ---- */
 
.wsu-afford-compare .wsu-column {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}
.wsu-afford-compare .wsu-container {
  flex: 1;
}
 
.wsu-afford-net {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
}
.wsu-afford-net__label {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
  margin-bottom: 6px !important;
}
.wsu-afford-net__amt {
  line-height: 1;
  margin-bottom: 0 !important;
}
.wsu-afford-net__amt .wsu-afford--stat-value {
  font-size: 64px;
  color: #FFFFFF;
}
 
 
/* ---- Four steps ---- */
 
.wsu-afford-step + .wsu-afford-step {
  border-top: 1px solid #CCC9C8; /* light gray */
}
 
.wsu-afford-step__num {
  display: inline-block;
  background: #EFEBE5; /* warm stone */
  border-bottom: 3px solid #056872; /* river, overridden per step below */
  border-radius: 4px 4px 0 0;
  padding: 2px 12px 0;
  margin-right: 12px;
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.6;
  vertical-align: middle;
}
.wsu-afford-step--1 .wsu-afford-step__num { border-bottom-color: #056872; } /* river */
.wsu-afford-step--2 .wsu-afford-step__num { border-bottom-color: #E9C576; } /* wheat field */
.wsu-afford-step--3 .wsu-afford-step__num { border-bottom-color: #67A272; } /* evergreen */
.wsu-afford-step--4 .wsu-afford-step__num { border-bottom-color: #6AC9CE; } /* alpine lake */
 
 
/* ---- Cougar Commitment checklist ---- */
 
.wsu-afford-checklist {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 10px 24px;
}
.wsu-afford-checklist li {
  position: relative;
  padding-left: 30px;
  margin: 0;
}
.wsu-afford-checklist li::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: 5px;
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #67A272; /* evergreen */
}
.wsu-afford-checklist li::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: 6px;
  top: 8px;
  width: 5px;
  height: 9px;
  border: solid #000000;
  border-width: 0 2px 2px 0;
  transform: rotate(45deg);
}
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .wsu-afford-checklist { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}
 
 
/* ---- Value list (moved out of the Custom HTML block) ---- */
 
.wsu-value-list {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
}
.wsu-value-list li {
  background: #EFEBE5; /* warm stone */
  border-left: 4px solid #056872; /* river */
  border-radius: 0;
  padding: 20px 24px;
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #262626;
  line-height: 1.55;
}
.wsu-value-list li:nth-child(2) { border-left-color: #E9C576; } /* wheat field */
.wsu-value-list li:nth-child(3) { border-left-color: #67A272; } /* evergreen */
.wsu-value-list li:nth-child(4) { border-left-color: #6AC9CE; } /* alpine lake */

.wsu-afford-guarantee a{
	color: white;
}

	.wsu-afford--footer-cta-row{
		flex-direction: column;
	}

      sticky.setAttribute('aria-hidden', shouldShow ? 'false' : 'true');
    });
  }, { threshold: 0, rootMargin: '0px 0px 0px 0px' });

  observer.observe(btnRow);
});

.wsu-afford-checklist {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 10px 24px;
}
.wsu-afford-checklist li {
  position: relative;
  padding-left: 30px;
  margin: 0;
}
.wsu-afford-checklist li::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: 5px;
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #67A272; /* evergreen */
}
.wsu-afford-checklist li::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: 6px;
  top: 8px;
  width: 5px;
  height: 9px;
  border: solid #000000;
  border-width: 0 2px 2px 0;
  transform: rotate(45deg);
}
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .wsu-afford-checklist { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}
 
 
/* ---- Value list (moved out of the Custom HTML block) ---- */
 
.wsu-value-list {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
}
.wsu-value-list li {
  background: #EFEBE5; /* warm stone */
  border-left: 4px solid #056872; /* river */
  border-radius: 0;
  padding: 20px 24px;
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #262626;
  line-height: 1.55;
}
.wsu-value-list li:nth-child(2) { border-left-color: #E9C576; } /* wheat field */
.wsu-value-list li:nth-child(3) { border-left-color: #67A272; } /* evergreen */
.wsu-value-list li:nth-child(4) { border-left-color: #6AC9CE; } /* alpine lake */

.wsu-afford-guarantee a{
	color: white;
}

@media screen and (max-width: 767px) {
	.wsu-afford--footer-cta-row{
		flex-direction: column;

    entries.forEach(function(entry) {

      sticky.setAttribute('aria-hidden', shouldShow ? 'false' : 'true');
    });
  }, { threshold: 0, rootMargin: '0px 0px 0px 0px' });

  observer.observe(btnRow);
});

  padding-left: 30px;
  margin: 0;
}

  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: 5px;
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #67A272; /* evergreen */
}
.wsu-afford-checklist li::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: 6px;
  top: 8px;
  width: 5px;
  height: 9px;
  border: solid #000000;
  border-width: 0 2px 2px 0;
  transform: rotate(45deg);
}

  .wsu-afford-checklist { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}

});
